messages:
maya_support: Hi team — escalating a customer issue (org_451). They say free-tier credits were consumed before a promo applied this morning. Dashboard shows 0 free credits at 07:02 UTC, invoice shows promo applied later but charges didn't get offset. Can someone look?

alex.k: Thanks. Do we have a request_id / ledger_id from the customer or a billing ticket number? Any screenshots?

maya_support: Ticket #CS-3227 attached: screenshot of dashboard (+api usage log). They included this meter event snippet: `metering-service: record_usage org=org_451 tokens=1200 req_id=req_8f2a timestamp=2026-11-08T06:59:12Z` then later `promo-service: assign_promo org=org_451 promo=FREE-2026-10 expiration=2026-11-08T07:05:00Z applied=false` — customer claims promo assignment happened ~3m after usage and then credits should have been retro-applied.

jamal_billing: I pulled ledger rows for org_451 around that window. We have usage entries at 06:59:12 and invoice generation at 07:10, promo assignment recorded at 07:05 but our billing aggregator has a windowed-join that only picks promos with start_time <= usage_time. If promo applied after usage_time it won't retro-apply unless a separate reprocessing job runs.

billing-bot: [auto] Promo assignment event received: promo_id=FREE-2026-10 org=org_451 event_ts=1778459912 stream_offset=54321

linda_eng: This sounds like a race between the promo-assignment consumer and the usage-aggregator. We recently moved consumer offsets to commit in the promo-service which may delay downstream propagation. Can we repro locally?

maya_support: Customer insists promo was purchased/activated before usage due to timezone confusion — they activated in app at 07:01 local (UTC+2). Their screenshot of the promo modal timestamp is 07:00:45 UTC. But our ledger shows promo record_ts=07:05:12.

alex.k: Repro steps request: 1) get raw events from s3/kinesis for org_451 between 06:55 and 07:10 2) run the join locally to check ordering 3) check aggregator backlog (kinesis->consumer lag) 4) ensure reprocessing path works (re-run job for that org id).

linda_eng: Agreed. Quick check commands: 
```
# list promo events
aws s3 ls s3://redwood-events/prod/promo/2026-11-08/ | grep org_451
# tail usage stream
kinesis-console tail --stream metering-stream --from-seq 54250 --to 54500 --filter org=org_451
```
I also want the trace id from the aggregator service logs (trace=agg-xxxx).

jamal_billing: Found ledger fragment: `ledger_row id=lg_9901 org=org_451 usage_tokens=1200 time=2026-11-08T06:59:12Z billed_amount=0.012` Invoice row: `invoice_789 total=0.012 promo_applied=false`. There is an earlier promo assignment event in UI but no server-side confirmation until 07:05:12.

maya_support: Customer pasted UI timestamp — possible client-side clock. They want immediate fix and credit. Can we do manual remediation?

linda_eng: Manual remediation options: (A) re-run the billing reprocess for the single day / org which will join promo events post-facto and re-emit corrected invoice (preferred), (B) apply an off-cycle credit to customer account now to make them whole and then fix reprocess to avoid repeated issues. We'll need billing signoff for off-cycle credits.

jamal_billing: I'm OK with an off-cycle credit for CS-3227 while engineering kicks off reprocess. Please include exact amount and reason. Also need audit note for finance.

alex.k: Root cause hypothesis: promo-assignment confirmation event hits UI/back-end but the canonical promo registry write goes to the promo-topic which had a consumer lag due to a GC pause on the promo-service host. That made server-side record_ts > client timestamp. Fix path: tighten the producer ack path or accept eventual consistency and trigger an immediate reprocess when promo assignment API returns success (i.e., synchronous ledger write).

linda_eng: I'll open an eng ticket to change the promo assignment flow: either 1) make server-side write synchronous before returning success, or 2) emit a forced reprocess-event for the org after assignment. Short-term patch: add a TTL-based reprocess job that catches promos applied within X minutes of usage.

maya_support: Customer update queued — offering temporary credit and ETA for fix: 24h for reprocess + invoice correction.

billing-bot: [action] Created reprocess job job_id=rp_20261108_451, queued at offset 54600.

alex.k: For postmortem we also need to collect: a) consumer lag metrics for promo-topic for that day b) number of similar incidents in last 30d c) telemetry linking promo assignment API responses to canonical registry writes (correlation id).

linda_eng: I'll run the two queries and attach to CS-3227. Also scheduling a quick sync with billing tomorrow 09:00 UTC.

maya_support: Thanks. I'll let customer know and keep thread updated. :thumbsup:

jamal_billing: Done: issued off-cycle credit txn_id=cr_5543 amount=0.012 reason="promo retro-apply - CS-3227". Finance notified.

maya_support: Customer confirmed credit received. Closing for now but leaving ticket open until reprocess completes.

linda_eng: Marking follow-ups: eng-incident for promo race, add unit test for producer ack path, backfill one-off reprocess metrics.

alex.k: Nice work. If reprocess finds other affected orgs, we'll batch credits in a single run to reduce finance overhead.

billing-bot: [auto] Reprocess job rp_20261108_451 completed status=success affected_invoices=1 corrected_amount=0.012

maya_support: Reprocess done and invoice corrected. Customer is happy. Closing CS-3227.
